text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold A and E, and later B, while each was above my average cost; I should not let the discomfort of admitting a loss make me cling to losing positions or rush to take gains.","A stock being up since I bought it does not tell me whether it is a good hold now; I should judge each trade by its future prospects and risk, not its personal break-even point.","My account value fell in some periods despite profitable sales, and past price moves do not predict future ones; I should focus on the whole portfolio and avoid trading just because I check it often."]}
